newsitem.title: USA: Manufactured Home Q4 funds from oper up.
newsitem.headline: Manufactured Home Q4 funds from oper up.

text.p: Manufactured Home Communities said Thursday its funds from operations rose to $10.9 million or $0.40 a share, up from $9.2 million or $0.34 a share in the year-ago quarter.
For the year, Manufactured Homes had funds from operations of $42.2 million or $1.54 a share, up from $34.5 million or $1.28 in 1995.
The company reported net income per share of $0.24 for the fourth quarter 1996 versus $0.16 a share the previous year.
Manufactured Home, a real estate investment trust, said its results are a reflection of efforts to increase funds from operations, reduce expenses and maximize operating efficiencies.
During 1996 the company said it acquired four communities for a total price of $44 million. Two of the newly purchased communities are in Arizona, one is in Delaware and the other is in Indiana.
